info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Utility Billing Estimates-v3-spec
info.description: The Utility Billing Estimates API allows users to retrieve a list of estimated billing amounts for utility services. This endpoint serves as a critical resource for stakeholders such as utility companies, financial analysts, and customer service representatives, enabling them to access and analyze estimated billing data. Typical use cases include forecasting revenue, assessing billing cycles, and providing customers with expected charges. With this API, consumers can effectively manage their utility billing processes and enhance customer engagement.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch estimated billing information based on provided criteria. It helps users understand potential costs before actual billing occurs.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving a billing estimate. This should contain the necessary parameters to calculate the estimate, formatted as a JSON object.

ListUtilityBillingEstimatesRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to billing estimates.

ListUtilityBillingEstimatesResponse_200.title: Billing Estimate Response

status.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: Unique identifier for the billing estimate.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the estimate operation.

state.description: Current state of the billing estimate.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the request, in milliseconds.

message.description: Message providing additional information about the operation.

ListUtilityBillingEstimatesResponse_200.description: This schema defines the structure of the response returned upon a successful billing estimate operation.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The user who created the billing estimate.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the billing estimate was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the billing estimate was created automatically.

AuditInfo.description: This schema captures the audit details related to the billing estimate operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request.
